headline: Adds a movable Food & Drink bar to BetterBags Next.

entries.title: Food & Drink bar in BetterBags Next
entries.details: A movable on-screen card in BetterBags Next shows food and drink from your backpack (highest or lowest item level), bags open or closed. Right-click to eat or drink, or drop it on the backpack to turn off. Set options under Food & Drink after Currencies, with a Food & Drink Masque group.
